notes: 2026-27 is the second and final season of the 2025-27 domestic cycle: RTVE (free-to-air, La 1/Teledeporte) holds the main package and sublicenses at least 55 matches per season to Movistar Plus+; no 2027-28+ domestic deal was found. The final is sold separately by the RFEF and its 2026-27 broadcaster was not found. International rights (all rounds except the final) are sold by LaLiga via Peak Sport Media from 2025-26; confirmed deals found: Disney+ (Nordics, to 2029-30), DAZN (Italy), Premier Sports (UK & Ireland), ESPN+ (USA, to 2026-27). All other international entries come only from the English Wikipedia Copa del Rey broadcasters table (undated, mostly unreferenced) and are flagged as unconfirmed for 2026-27. No official per-country list exists on laliga.com or rfef.es (rfef.es and rtve.es were not reachable). Web search quota was exhausted mid-research, so further 2025-26/2026-27 international deals could not be searched.

RTVE holds the main domestic package (Lot 1, up to 116 matches per season, excluding the preliminary round and the final) on a two-year RFEF deal covering 2025-26 and 2026-27 (tender run by LaLiga); RTVE keeps the top-pick match of each round (shown on its free-to-air channels). Movistar Plus+ sublicensed at least 55 exclusive matches per season for 2025-26 and 2026-27 (Xataka, 24 Oct 2025: https://www.xatakahome.com/servicios-de-smart-tv/movistar-plus-vuelve-a-hacer-emitira-50-partidos-copa-rey-su-nuevo-acuerdo-rtve); semi-finals simulcast by RTVE and Movistar Plus+. Channel names: the es.wikipedia 2026-27 infobox lists Teledeporte (FTA), Movistar Plus+ / LaLiga por M+ and FAN PLAY TV (subscription), and regional/local FTA channels Esport3, Aragón TV, TV Canaria, À Punt, IB3, TPA7, CMM TV and Betevé (https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copa_del_Rey_de_f%C3%BAtbol_2026-27); La 1 is listed in the 2025-26 infobox (https://es.wikipedia.org/wiki/Copa_del_Rey_de_f%C3%BAtbol_2025-26). Regional/local channels and FAN PLAY TV possibly relate to the separately sold, non-exclusive preliminary-round rights; exact match allocation not specified. Orange also joined as a domestic broadcaster (Sportcal, Dec 2025; role not specified). The final is sold separately by the RFEF; the 2026-27 final (24 April 2027, Seville) broadcaster is not confirmed. HORECA (bars) rights sold separately, non-exclusive.
